tool_args.rationale: The archived saturating base with fractional sink inhibition and a positive square-root branch fits all five paid rows to reporting precision. The fitted sink fraction is about 0.724 and the branch coefficient is about 0.393. Submit this three-parameter model for fresh confirmation without another paid probe.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Even allowing a positive linear gain, the fit at the archived half-saturation constant has pilot RMSE 0.0147, versus 3.6e-8 for the square-root branch.
The pilot already spans sink gradients from 0.25 to 2.20 and distinguishes the archived branch forms at the reported measurement precision.
The static siphon explains all five observations at reporting precision, and the pilot is already at the target horizon.
